title: Product Lifecycle Project Manager- 5-8 years of proven experience in PLM, NPI/Sustaining, hardware development, manufacturing operations, and/or end-to-end supply chain engineering.
teaser: We are looking for a Product Lifecycle Project Manager to drive operational efficiency and support Cisco's product portfolio from launch to end-of-life. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, manage change, and implement PLM strategies. Ideal candidates have significant experience in PLM, NPI/Sustaining, or supply chain engineering.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/05/2026
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet the Team 

Become part of Cisco's Product Operation team under Global Supply Chain organization. We are seeking a Product Lifecycle Project Manager to join our dynamic team—a high-impact group dedicated to ensuring the success, profitability, and quality of Cisco's product portfolio from initial launch to end-of-life (EoL). In this role, you will support the product lifecycle from post-production ramp through its End of Life (EoL). You will improve operational efficiency, manage change management and drive innovation and transformation across NPI, sustaining, and end-to-end supply chain processes.

Your Impact 

In this role, you will collaborate with peers, senior leaders, and functional SMEs to assess current PLM processes, define a future state vision, and implement solutions that improve operational efficiency and business performance. You will:

Contribute to the development and execution of supply chain and PLM strategies that strengthen processes, improve efficiency, and support organizational objectives.

Work closely with teams within Product Operations, Global Manufacturing Operations (GMO), Global Planning (GP), Quality, Product Marketing, Services, Engineering, and other key supply chain groups to align priorities, shape decisions, and deliver meaningful organizational impact.

Analyse data and processes multiple functions to identify improvement opportunities and enable scalable, efficient operations.

Champion change by advocating for innovative, future-ready solutions and guiding teams through process and policy transformations.

Identify and mitigate operational and supply chain risks through cross-functional engagement and clear definition of key PLM processes.

Facilitate design-thinking and business-sensing sessions to surface emerging challenges, understand BU needs, and ensure strategies are aligned with organizational goals.

Minimum Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, or in Supply Chain, or related field; advanced degrees/certifications a plus.

5+ years of experience in PLM, NPI/Sustaining, hardware development, manufacturing operations, and/or end-to-end supply chain engineering.

5+ years of experience leading cross-functional initiatives in a supply chain operations environment.

Proven skills in global process design/standardization, program management, and risk identification/mitigation.

Strong communication, analytical, and systems skills, with the ability to learn Cisco’s supply chain dynamics quickly. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Strong global project management background, including engagement with multiple geographic locations- preferably in EMS/OEM industry.

Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to lead and influence multi-functional teams without direct authority.

Good at presentation and communication. Excellent communication and follow-up skills, ability to manage multiple tasks, strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Data-driven problem solver with strong analytical abilities and a focus on operational excellence.

Experience using program management tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet) 

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
